title.rendered: Project Management of a new Dual MRI Facility at Walsall Manor Hospital – InHealth Group

content.rendered:
[vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1603234156399{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”][vc_column width=”2/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1603234254363{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1603234209126{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”]We worked for and on behalf of InHealth Group, to Project Manage the design and build of a new dual MRI scanning Department at Walsall Manor Hospital. This project ran for eighteen months in duration and the turnkey build contract was substantial. We worked closely with InHealths’ appointed design team which included architects, ABC as Turnkey Principle Contractor, draughtsmen, quantity surveyors , logistics and procurement teams.

This important project helped InHealth to upscale their scanning capacity to serve many more patients from the wider community which in turn helped the trust to cope with their increased demand.

The new facility was designed to be a great environment and to promote the best possible patient and staff experience. The department was designed and built carefully to meet current building and safety regulations.

Siemens Healthineers delivered two Siemens Magnetom Aera 1.5T MRI scanners into this facility and worked out of hours to minimise disruption to both staff and patients.

The project presented many challenges, some of which were known and others we met along the way, by working collectively we were able to overcome them one by one to complete and deliver a superb new facility.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1603234260575{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”][vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1603234223885{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”]Details
